_README: The tracked prompt set. This is the measurement instrument for how visible Imagineers.ai is inside ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. It lives in the repo so it is version controlled: a prompt set that changes between runs measures nothing.
_HOW_TO_RUN: Run every prompt against each engine, at least three times, and record whether Imagineers.ai is named and which domains are cited. Three runs because the outputs are stochastic and a single run is noise, not a reading. Put the results in citation-landscape.md. Monthly is the minimum useful cadence.
_TARGETS: Under roughly 20 percent inclusion on a stage is a red zone and needs work. The three prompts marked "commercial": true are the ones that matter most and are tracked on their own line.
_NO_SELF_PROMOTION: Nothing in this file is to be posted anywhere. It is a measuring tool. Posting prompt-shaped content into Reddit or a forum to influence an answer is the behaviour that gets accounts banned and domains distrusted.
